title: FEAT-001: Library snapshot
description:
The on-disk cache of the last successful GET /api/recipes response. Written by NetworkRecipeRepository after a successful fetch; read by SnapshotCache on launch so the library is legible with no network. This shape crosses the disk boundary and must survive an app upgrade, which is why it is pinned here.

The recipe objects inside it are NOT defined here. Their canonical definition is fuji-recipes-book/specs/shared/recipe.schema.json, and duplicating it would guarantee drift. The snapshot stores the server's response bodies verbatim and does not re-validate them on read: a recipe the server considered valid is a recipe this cache will return, including any field a newer server version added that this build does not understand.

snapshotVersion.description: Version of THIS envelope, not of the recipe format. Incremented only when the envelope's own fields change. A snapshot whose version this build does not recognise is discarded and refetched — it is a cache, so throwing it away costs one request.

fetchedAt.description: When the response that produced this snapshot was received, by the device clock. Shown to the user in the offline banner ('showing a copy taken …'). Device time, so it is a display value and never used for ordering or conflict resolution.

baseUrl.description: The API base URL this snapshot was fetched from. Compared on read: a snapshot taken from a different deployment is discarded rather than shown, so pointing the app at a second instance never displays the first one's library.

recipes.description: The `recipes` array from the response body, stored verbatim and in the order received (sortKey ascending, ties already broken by createdAt). Order is preserved because the client's sorts fall back to manual order and re-deriving it from the stored keys must produce the same list.

items.description: One recipe, exactly as the server sent it. Canonical shape: fuji-recipes-book/specs/shared/recipe.schema.json. Open by design — unknown top-level keys are preserved so a field written by a newer client survives a round trip through this one (fuji-recipes-book/specs/data-model.md §1, the `extra` column).

notes.description: Free text, up to 2000 characters. Not shown on a card.

rating.description: 0-5. 0 means unrated and the card omits the rating pill entirely rather than showing a zero.

tags.description: Up to 20 tags, each 1-30 characters. May be empty.

sortKey.description: Fractional manual-order key, a signed double — negatives are legal. Assigned by the server; the client never computes one.

settings.description: The camera parameter set. Only `filmSimulation` is read by this feature — for the badge, the swatch and the label. Every other key is carried through untouched and interpreted by FEAT-002.

filmSimulation.description: Film simulation id. An id absent from the transcribed table renders with the fallback swatch #9CA3AF and its raw id as the label, rather than failing to render the card.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC with milliseconds. The tiebreaker in manual order.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC with milliseconds. The key for the 'Recently updated' sort. Not touched by a reorder.

lastWrittenSlot.description: Camera custom slot 1-7, or null. Written by the web client. The Android client does not model, display or track this field — it rides through in `extra` untouched, so declining to use it never destroys it.

lastWrittenAt.description: When the last successful camera write happened, or null. Written by the web client; carried through by the Android client but never displayed or updated.

recipes.name: Kodachrome 64
recipes.notes: Warm midday light, ETERNA is too flat for this.
